title.zh: Samsung Wallet to Bring Stablecoin Access to Eligible Galaxy Users in the US
title.en: Samsung Wallet to Bring Stablecoin Access to Eligible Galaxy Users in the US

current_state.zh: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
current_state.en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.

updates.title_zh: 三星钱包将为美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户提供稳定币访问
updates.title_en: Samsung Wallet to Bring Stablecoin Access to Eligible Galaxy Users in the US
updates.what_changed_zh:
三星宣布，Samsung Wallet 将为美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户提供稳定币访问，把美元支持的加密资产带给主流智能手机用户群体。相关报道将该功能描述为支持 USDC，使美国 Galaxy 用户可以将资金转入银行账户和加密钱包，并计划未来扩展到更多国家。

此举通过一家全球大型设备厂商，把美元支持的稳定币直接呈现在大众智能手机用户面前，形成了一条与加密原生应用和交易所不同的消费者触达渠道。

该消息停留在标题层面的承诺；有关此次整合的报道指出，稳定币发行方、完整支持代币清单等多项实施细节尚未披露。搜索摘录还提到，该功能初期仅面向美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户，未来将扩展至更多国家。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
updates.background_zh: 稳定币是一种旨在相对于某一参考资产（最常见的是美元等法定货币）保持价值稳定的加密货币，依靠储备资产或算法机制实现，但顾名思义，稳定币并不总能维持锚定。Samsung Wallet 是三星在 Galaxy 设备上的移动钱包，此前主要用于支付卡、票券与数字钥匙，而非加密资产转账。随着交易规模上升，稳定币的发行与使用在全球各地日益受到监管关注。
updates.background_en: A stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency designed to maintain a stable value relative to a reference asset, most commonly a fiat currency such as the US dollar, using reserve assets or algorithmic mechanisms; despite the name, stablecoins have not always held their peg. Samsung Wallet is Samsung's mobile wallet on Galaxy devices, which has primarily handled payment cards, passes and keys rather than crypto transfers. Stablecoin issuance and usage have increasingly drawn regulatory attention across jurisdictions as transaction volumes have grown.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是消费者分发与托管：在一款大众市场的手机厂商钱包中嵌入美元稳定币转账，可能拓宽美元稳定币的零售入口，并使部分点对点支付流量从加密原生应用分流，实际影响规模取决于最终支持的代币、费用与覆盖地区。受影响最直接的板块包括美元稳定币发行方、争夺同一 Galaxy 用户群的移动钱包与支付服务商，以及三星自身的设备服务生态。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is consumer distribution and custody: embedding dollar stablecoin transfers in a mass-market OEM wallet could widen the retail on-ramp for dollar stablecoins and shift some peer-to-peer payment flows away from crypto-native apps, with the scale of any effect depending on which tokens, fees and geographies are ultimately supported. Segments most directly exposed are dollar stablecoin issuers, mobile wallet and payments providers competing for the same Galaxy user base, and Samsung's own device-services ecosystem.
